I am working in localization and always find it a bit limiting when websites and services are only offered in English. Since voat is based in Europe, where we have a lot of languages, I would like to make a localized interface for voat. I would be able to take on the German translation and testing on my own and I'm sure there are people on here that could provide the translations for the other European languages or maybe even Asian languages.

I'm sure all of you are fine with English, but in terms of growing the page, I think a fully localized version could be a good thing.

As for me, I have worked in localization for a couple of years for some big and small companies like Blizzard, Apple and EA. I have seen how many users are pissed off when they don't get content or at least the interface in their language.

People not fluent in English are fine with reading English, but having the same language barrier, especially when creating accounts or figuring out site settings, privacy, whatever, is a deterrent. You only need to understand half or less of the words to understand most of the content, but if you only have one word on a button, or bullet points, you're shit out of luck.

I think you raise a good point. My thought is that with the size of the English language subs, this will likely never be a problem. If Voat ever becomes language diverse enough that you're regularly seeing non-English content in /v/all, Voat could implement filtering tools or language settings to filter out non-English subs, or you could use existing subverse blocking tools to block non-English subs from showing up in /v/all.
